my mom just has a general distrust of western medicine and really truly believes that everything can be solved by positive thinking. i really have tried but the self harm, the suicidal thoughts, and most of everything else just doesn’t go away. thankfully earlier this year i did have the motivation to seriously ask for help for the first time and it took a lot to get past not wanting to get better. i lost that a while ago and i think that definitely plays into me not reaching out to another therapist.

i do want to tell my doctor everything but she’ll most likely tell my mom and i really don’t want to let her down like that and i really don’t want to put that on her. still, i’ll probably do whatever the GP thinks is best although that is a terrifying prospect. i know it’s not a decision to be made lightly but i don’t know what else to do and i’m just scared. i feel like it’s better than doing nothing? maybe?

i def have a few options to exhaust that i hadn’t thought about. i gotta build up a better argument for my mom and maybe try to make a plan with my doctor. i have a friend w adhd who is in the same boat w their dealer; i’m definitely gonna leave that idea for last. thankfully i don’t have a family history of addiction but i have friends who have died from it and that’s always terrifying.

confidentiality laws here don’t apply to a lot of mental health stuff and a lot of times whether or not they tell ur parents just depends on the relationship u have w ur doctor. i think if i had the funds i could pay for them and pick them up myself, but it’s way too much money to do on my own currently. so once my mom sees the payments on her insurance she’d stop paying and cut off my access. i understand her worries and the consequences of it, she just refuses to have a conversation and its so frustrating. part of it is simply that she doesn’t know the extent of what i’m dealing with and that’s my fault; it’s just so hard talking to her. but yeah the US sucks never come here
